hook: Their boat flipped. Three people were in the water.
narration: Their boat flipped near Anacapa Island, and three people ended up in the water.
A Coast Guard boat crew from Station Channel Islands Harbor reached the overturned hull.
A rescue swimmer from Point Mugu was there to help them.
A flipped hull still floats, so crews tell boaters to stay with the boat.
outcome: All three were pulled from the water and taken to Station Channel Islands, where medics waited.
title: Boat flipped, 3 people in the water
description:
A Coast Guard Station Channel Islands Harbor boatcrew and a rescue swimmer from Air Station San Francisco Forward Operating Base Point Mugu assisted three people from the water after their vessel capsized near Anacapa Island, California, on June 22, 2018.
